_provenance.method: document-class extensions attributable to a study, from the existing corpus catalogue. No re-walk of the share.
_provenance.identifiers: counts only. No path, study name or filename stem is in this file. The sample file carries paths and is local.
_provenance.exclusion_match: first match wins, in this order: system files by raw prefix ~$, ._, .~lock; then boilerplate by prefix of the stem lowercased and stripped to [a-z0-9]; then the named buckets by whole tokens of the lowercased stem, optional plural s
_provenance.coverage: placed files only. A file with no taxonomy folder above it has no study and is not counted. breadth_studies and volume_files count the candidate frame: kept documents, which include manuscripts, SAS output, other non-reports and nested study keys. They are not report counts and not bounds on the corpus in either direction; see skipped.unplaced for what the frame leaves out.
_provenance.script: 2026-11-12-ar-census.py with the boilerplate bucket (#537). exclusion_match is the text the script now writes; the lri run predates that wording change, which altered no count.

stage1_upper_bound._note: the folder split is REPORTED, not filtered on. Anything outside the documents folder is the part a folder-based rule would miss. System files (lock, AppleDouble) are not in this stage.

stage2_after_named_exclusions._note: a partition: each stem lands in its FIRST matching bucket, so the buckets sum to excluded_total. system_artifact rows were never in stage 1, so stage1 - stage2 = excluded_total - system_artifact.

reports_per_study._note: the figure that decides whether breadth or volume is the right column. Measured, not assumed. Counts files, so drafts inflate it; compare volume_reports_drafts_collapsed.

unplaced._note: no taxonomy folder above the file, so no study. Reports kept this way are invisible to every other figure here.

exports_not_counted._note: a PDF is usually an export of a report that also exists as Word, so counting it here would double-count. Carried so the decision is visible rather than silent.

what_this_still_does_not_know: Which of the kept files is an analysis report rather than a manuscript, a summary of one table, or a document nobody finished. Stage 3 answers this and nothing else can.

Whether a report covers one research question or several. The 2026-11-11 design scaffolds one job per question; the corpus may not have worked that way, and if it did not, the template count and the report count are different numbers again.
